project_type: Vite 5 + React 18 + TypeScript (strict) SPA client for the Aurinara Clinical Artifact Platform FastAPI backend. shadcn/ui (new-york style, zinc base), Tailwind v4, TanStack Router (file-based, pathless _app layout) + TanStack Query, Orval-generated typed API client.
build_system: Vite 5 with @vitejs/plugin-react and @tanstack/router-plugin (autoCodeSplitting regenerates src/routeTree.gen.ts on dev/build). Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/vite. Package manager: npm. Working directory for ALL commands is the frontend/ folder (e:\Work\EDETEK\Python\aurinara\frontend), NOT the repo root.
test_framework: None. package.json has no test script and no vitest/jest dependency. Do NOT add a test runner for this task. Verification is build + lint only.
build_command: npm run build  (runs `tsc -b && vite build` — the authoritative zero-type-error gate)
test_command: npm run lint  (runs `eslint .` — must report ZERO errors). npm run typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) is a faster inner-loop check.
verification_instructions: From frontend/: 1) if package.json dependencies changed, run `npm install` first. 2) `npm run build` must complete with zero TypeScript errors. 3) `npm run lint` must report zero errors. Baseline (pre-change) state: typecheck passes clean; `eslint .` exits 0 with exactly 3 pre-existing react-refresh/only-export-components WARNINGS in src/components/ui/badge.tsx, button.tsx, sidebar.tsx — these are warnings, not errors, and are acceptable. Do not let error count rise above 0. Also sanity-check that the dashboard (/), studies (/studies), and login/signup pages still render and the _app auth guard still redirects unauthenticated users.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is generated by @tanstack/router-plugin on dev/build and MUST NOT be hand-edited; the 12 route files already exist under src/routes/_app/ so no manual route registration is needed. Everything under src/api/generated/** is Orval-generated and read-only (regenerated via `npm run api:sync`); do not edit it — only import its exported hooks and model types.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell shell. Generated files use CRLF; ripgrep-based content search may miss matches in src/api/generated — prefer reading files directly or PowerShell Select-String there. Run every npm command with cwd = frontend/.
contribution_requirements: Repo AGENTS.md is backend-focused; the cross-cutting rule relevant here is 'the generated client is read-only' (do not edit src/api/generated/**). No frontend-specific AGENTS.md or steering files exist. Match the existing shadcn/ui authoring style exactly: `data-slot` attributes, `cn()` from @/lib/utils, `cva` only where the upstream new-york component uses variants. React component files that also export a hook/non-component must carry `// eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components` above that export (see src/components/auth-provider.tsx for the pattern).
key_patterns: VERIFIED generated hook facts (confirmed by reading src/api/generated): (A) Collection responses `{ items: T[] }` -> normalize `data?.items ?? []`: useListRawAggregates/useListSdtmAggregates/useListAdamAggregates/useListTlfAggregates (AggregateCollection), useListArtifacts (ArtifactCollection), useListStudies (StudyCollection). (B) Array responses `T[]` -> normalize `data ?? []`: useListDocuments(DocumentResponse[]), useListReviewItems(ReviewItemResponse[]), useListIntegrations(IntegrationResponse[]), useListExtensions(ExtensionResponse[]), useListStudyRulePacks/useListPlatformRulePacks(RulePackResponse[]), useListRules(RuleResponse[]), useListStandards(StandardProductResponse[]), useListReleases(TerminologyReleaseResponse[]), useListTemplates(CatalogIdentity[]), useListReconciliationIssues(ListReconciliationIssues200Item[] = {[k:string]:unknown}[]). (C) Hook arity — query options object is ALWAYS the last positional arg: 3-positional (studyId, params?, options?) for useListRawAggregates/useListSdtmAggregates/useListAdamAggregates/useListTlfAggregates/useListArtifacts (MUST pass `undefined` for params to reach options: `useListSdtmAggregates(id, undefined, { query: { enabled } })`); 2-positional (studyId, options?) for useListDocuments/useListReviewItems/useListIntegrations/useListExtensions/useListStudyRulePacks; params/options-only (NO studyId) for useListStandards(params?,options?)/useListReleases(params?,options?)/useListTemplates(options?)/useListRules(options?)/useListPlatformRulePacks(options?); lookup-by-id for useGetReconciliation(runId,options?)/useListReconciliationIssues(runId,options?). (D) Error typing: `ErrorType<E> = AxiosError<E>` is exported from src/api/axios-instance.ts (NOT the generated tree); shared error prop MUST be typed `AxiosError | null` imported from 'axios' (NOT `ErrorType<unknown>` — AxiosError<HTTPValidationError> is not assignable to AxiosError<unknown> under strict TS); hook errors pass through with no cast. (E) VERIFIED model fields: AggregateResponse{id,study_id,code,name,status,revision,document_type?}; DocumentResponse{...document_code,name,document_type,status,revision,updated_at}; ReviewItemResponse{...target_module,target_entity_type,question,priority,status,revision,updated_at}; IntegrationResponse{...integration_code,display_name,direction,status,revision,updated_at}; ExtensionResponse{...code,name,codelist_code,status,revision}; RulePackResponse{...code,name,lifecycle,revision,updated_at}; RuleResponse{...rule_id,version,module_key,default_severity,mandatory}; StandardProductResponse{id,code,name,provider,family,product_type,scope}; TerminologyReleaseResponse{...code,version,provider,product,lifecycle,content_schema_version}; CatalogIdentity{id,code,name}; ArtifactResponse{...module,artifact_type,filename,media_type,size,status,created_at}; ReconciliationResponse{...reconciliation_type,reconciliation_version,status,error_count,warning_count,info_count,started_at,completed_at}; StudyResponse{id,code,name,status,revision,created_by,created_at,updated_at}. (F) QueryClient defaults (src/lib/query-client.ts): staleTime 30s, retry 1, refetchOnWindowFocus false. (G) localStorage pattern: wrap read/write in try/catch and degrade (see src/lib/auth.ts).
